en.headline: Electoral Affairs Commission holds crisis meeting ahead of Sunday subsector vote
en.dek: Chairman David Lok chaired the session on Tuesday evening to review cybersecurity, security risks and contingency plans for the November 22 elections.
body: The Electoral Affairs Commission held a Crisis Management Committee meeting on Tuesday evening to prepare for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections on November 22.

Chairman David Lok received briefings from the Registration and Electoral Office, the Digital Policy Office and the police on preparations, including cybersecurity and security risk assessments, as well as polling-day arrangements and contingency measures.

Other departments including the Security Bureau, Home Affairs Department, Information Services Department, Department of Justice and Electrical and Mechanical Services Department also outlined their coordination work.

Lok said organising an election requires detailed planning throughout and thanked the bureaux and departments for their efforts in the final stage. The committee will help monitor the process on polling day to ensure it is open, honest and fair. Five ordinary polling stations will use the electronic poll register system.

zh.headline: 選管會舉行危機管理會議 為周日選委會選舉作準備
zh.dek: 主席陸啟康周二傍晚主持會議，檢視網絡安全、保安風險及應變計劃，確保11月22日投票日順利。
body: 選舉管理委員會周二傍晚舉行危機管理委員會會議，為將於11月22日舉行的2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉作準備。
主席陸啟康聽取選舉事務處、數字政策辦公室及警務處代表簡報籌備及協調工作，包括網絡安全及保安風險評估，以及投票日部署和特別事故應變措施。
保安局、民政事務總署、政府新聞處、律政司及機電工程署亦就相關工作作出簡報。
陸啟康表示選舉工程絕不簡單，各工序需要詳細規劃，並感謝各政策局及部門在最後階段的準備。委員會將協助在投票日密切監察，確保選舉公開、誠實及公平。是次選舉設五個一般投票站，使用電子選民登記冊系統。
